meta.title: HAPPYROOM — Celebrate Together. Anywhere.
meta.description: Create a cozy 3D birthday room in seconds, share one link, and celebrate live with friends anywhere. No app, no sign-up required.

common.comingSoonHint: Room creation and joining open in the next release. Everything on this page already works.

hero.title: Celebrate Together. Anywhere.
hero.subtitle: Create a beautiful 3D birthday room in under a minute, share one link, and gather as playful avatars to blow out the candles together — from any phone or browser.

steps.title: Three steps to a party
steps.subtitle: Built so the birthday person feels celebrated, not the host overwhelmed.

create.title: Create
create.body: Pick a theme, a cake and a time. Your room is ready in seconds — no account needed.

invite.title: Invite
invite.body: Share a private link or QR code in any chat app. Add an access code for extra privacy.

celebrate.title: Celebrate
celebrate.body: Friends join as avatars, leave wishes and gifts, and blow out the candles together in sync.

themes.subtitle: Two handcrafted presets for the birthday room. More celebrations are on the way.

privacy.title: Private, safe and kind by design
privacy.subtitle: A birthday is personal. HAPPYROOM is built so it stays that way.

unlisted.title: Unlisted, invite-only rooms
unlisted.body: Rooms never appear in search or public lists. Entry needs an invitation grant — and optionally an access code.

noAccount.title: No account required
noAccount.body: Guests join with just a display name. Hosts can create a room without signing up and keep a recovery code.

hostControls.title: Hosts stay in control
hostControls.body: Lock the room, mute chat, remove a guest, approve wishes and photos before anyone else sees them.

media.title: Your memories, not our marketing
media.body: Photos are only uploaded with your permission, shown after host approval, and can be deleted any time.

data.title: Minimal analytics
data.body: We count product events without names or messages. Without your consent, nothing identifies you or your device.

ages.title: Made for friends and family
ages.body: No public chat, no direct messages from strangers, no open-world discovery. Report and block are always one tap away.

finalCta.title: Their next birthday could feel like everyone’s there.
finalCta.subtitle: Because now, everyone can be.

consent.title: Help us improve HAPPYROOM?
consent.body: Allow a random, device-only ID so we can understand return visits. We never collect names, messages or contacts. Without it, we only count anonymous events.

steps.title: Create → Share → Celebrate
steps.subtitle: From idea to party in about a minute.

create.title: Create
create.body: Pick a theme, a cake and a time. Your 3D room is ready in seconds — no account needed.

share.title: Share
share.body: Send one private link or a room code in any chat app. Add an access code for extra privacy.

celebrate.title: Celebrate
celebrate.body: Friends join as avatars from any phone or browser and blow out the candles together, live.

unlisted.title: Unlisted unless the host opts in
unlisted.body: Rooms appear on the map only after their host chooses public discovery. An invite link alone never makes a room public.

location.title: Country, not location
location.body: The globe shows a host-chosen country — never your position, address or exact coordinates.

codes.title: Invites stay secret
codes.body: Invite links, access codes and names are never part of the public map.

finalCta.title: Put your celebration on the map
finalCta.subtitle: A cozy 3D room, one link, everyone together.
